## About
Greg's Honest Auto Repair is Greg's own shop, built on years as a technician and shop manager. He grew up in a small New England town, and the honesty and integrity his parents taught him are how he runs the place. Here you're treated like a VIP, not a sales statistic.
We don't use high pressure sales tactics or misleading information to get repair work. Greg personally road tests every vehicle before and after the work, so he knows what's going on and knows it's fixed. We use quality replacement parts that meet or exceed OEM specifications, installed by ASE certified technicians.
We're at North Street and Bennett Rd. in Longwood, and we hold a 4.8 rating from 75 Google reviews. One reviewer put it simply: Greg won't sell you anything you don't need.

## Services
- Engine Service and Repairs: Engine work on foreign and domestic vehicles, big or small.
- Brake Service and Repairs: Brake repairs, including ABS service. One reviewer said Greg gave him a thorough overview of his brake problem and detailed upfront pricing.
- Drivability Diagnostics: Tracking down how your car is running and why, with a road test to confirm.
- Cooling System Service and Repairs: Overheating, leaks and radiator work. One customer whose car overheated the day before Christmas was back on the road the day after.
- Air Conditioning Service and Repairs: A/C service and repair, including a visual inspection of all components and a test for proper refrigerant level.
- Used Vehicle Inspections: Have Greg look over a used car before you buy it.
- Synthetic Oil Change: Premium spin on oil filter, full synthetic oil and a safety inspection. Cartridge style filters are extra. ($78.95)
- Fuel Induction Service: Removes carbon buildup from the intake manifold, valves, pistons and injectors for better engine performance and fuel economy. ($119.95)

## FAQ
Q: I already bought my parts. Can you install them?
A: No problem. We'll be happy to give you a quote for labor only. One customer brought her own parts for a master brake cylinder and Greg had it done before noon.

Q: I have a coupon or an estimate from another shop. Should I bring it?
A: Yes, bring them with you and we'll take a look at the pricing.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are always free.

Q: What kinds of cars do you work on?
A: Foreign and domestic vehicles, and we specialize in BMW and Mercedes.
